snippet.title: BugSquash - Prototype Reveal
snippet.description:
BugSquash is a game where you play as a pest exterminator.

I got the idea one day when I was trying to squash a fly in the house and it was frustratingly harder than I expected. I got it eventually and thought, this could work as a game!

What you’re seeing here is a prototype.

Complete jobs to earn money
Hunt down bugs using your equipment and tools such as a classic swatter or a sound amplifier to detect bugs behind walls
Use your money to purchase and upgrade your equipment

BugSquash is still early in development, so there are plenty of improvements and new features to come, such as:
Additional equipment and tools to hunt bugs
Procedurally generated maps so each job feels new and fresh
Challenges for each job to earn bonus money, such as completing the job within a certain amount of time
The ability to break down walls to get pests that live inside walls
And of course, many different types of bugs to hunt, such as spiders, rats, roaches, wasps and other creepy crawlers you can think of

Release date is TBD, but if you’d like you can follow development at martilogames.com or youtube.com/@martilogames

Steam wishlist is also available! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522470/BugSquash/
